title: Backup and restore of a tree with long paths and accented names
description: Eleven files, two of them with relative paths longer than 260 characters, several with accented names, one empty; two nights of the chain, then a restore drill of the newest snapshot.
pass_criterion: Verdict OK, exit code 0; source count = count declared by the snapshot = restored count; every restored file re-hashed here has the SHA-256 of its source; an independent reference finds no differing file in either repository.
lesson: A restore is verified against the source manifest, file by file, or it is not verified.
